sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rudraige, also called Rory, is an Irish hero. He is a fairly modest figure in Irish myth. He led the Fir Bolg, the third group of invaders to reach Ireland. A mightier group, the Tuatha Dé Danann, overthrew them by the sword.

okr.objective: Present Rudraige as a leader of the Fir Bolg who fell in the ancient invasion.
key_results: He is a fairly obscure Irish hero.
